understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked with `+`, with all goals occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and progress through all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were grid-based with a limited step budget per level. MOVE_* would move the currently selected piece one tile in that direction unless blocked by walls/obstacles or illegal movement. CLICK on a valid target position would select or command movement/interaction with a piece at that coordinate; if the destination/path was blocked or the click had no valid effect, the piece would not move. Successful play required switching between selectable pieces and positioning them so they could occupy all `+` tiles at the same time.
